title: Gov. Ivey awards $250,000 grant for road improvements in Tallapoosa County
text: Gov. Ivey awards $250,000 grant for road improvements in Tallapoosa County A $250,000 grant has been awarded to the Tallapoosa County Commission for road improvements along Alabama Highway 49, aiming to enhance access to a new Ace Hardware store and facilitate future commercial development. The project includes drainage enhancements and road widening, with additional funding from the county and community block grants. MONTGOMERY, Ala. ( WSFA ) - A $250,000 grant is being given to the Tallapoosa County Commission for road improvements along a section of Alabama Highway 49 by Gov. Kay Ivey. The funds, provided by the Appalachian Regional Commission will be used to provide access to a new, 12,241-square-foot Ace Hardware store, which will create 11 jobs, according to the Alabama Department of Economic and Community Affairs (ADECA). The project is meant to benefit potential future commercial development at the site.Ivey highlights economic development benefits\"This upgrade will improve a stretch of highway that will continue to be an important access route for years to come,\" Ivey said. \"This project is an investment in economic development for Tallapoosa County which will pay dividends through business expansion and local job creation.\" The plans the project will include: Drainage improvements to increase safety and traffic flow Widening the road to accommodate turn lanes on both side of the highway. 100 acres of developable space for other restaurants and retail businesses in the future. \"These improvements to Highway 49 will translate to continued economic opportunities for Tallapoosa County,\" ADECA Director Kenneth Boswell said. \"ADECA is pleased to partner with the Appalachian Regional Commission and Ivey in support of these upgrades.Tallapoosa County adds matching funds\" Tallapoosa County will contribute an additional $50,000 in matching funds alongside a separate $250,000 in Community Development Block Grants funds that Ivey awarded in late 2025.
